description: Gradebook T4 observatory: the headline cost-per-correct-decision metric (ADR 0001; scoped to the math grade source, with reality shown in its own adjacent panels per C9/#54), per-model right-sizing evidence, correct-rate for the grade-quality-drop alert, cost-over-time for the spend-spike alert, and a clearly-labeled AI-judge secondary view that never counts toward the headline. Built for issue #7 (T4). All panels exclude the agent-gradebook-test harness service from the judge-facing numbers (#47). $decision_type, $model, and $grade_source dashboard variables (#48) replace the hardcoded decision-type allowlist; see panel-1's description for the exact scoping rules.
title: Gradebook: Cost per Correct Decision

widgets.description: Headline metric (ADR 0001, definition fixed in C9/#54): (sum(augmentloop.cost.usd) / count(correct decisions)) * 1000, scoped to augmentloop.grade.source = 'math'. The numerator A is ALL math cost - money spent on WRONG answers included - so this is what we spent per answer we got right, not the flattering cost-of-only-correct-answers version. Denominator B is correct math decisions. Scoping to math (a decision emits at most one math grade) structurally removes the earlier double-count that reality grades caused, so this reconciles to the cent with the CLI's total_cost / correct on the same run. Reality grades are NOT blended into this number - they have their own adjacent panels (reality correct rate & count). AI-judge grades are never in the headline (ADR 0001). SCOPING: augmentloop.decision.type is limited to the four model-decision types (route_choice from the toy world, filler_detection/quote_extraction/clip_scoring from the CleanCut substrate), deliberately excluding build_session, the #13 meta build-fleet unit - a whole agent session, not a single graded model decision - which skewed this headline 534x on 2026-07-25. SERVICE SCOPE (ruling recorded on #47, 2026-07-25): every panel additionally excludes service.name = 'agent-gradebook-test', a test harness whose graded decisions were reaching this judge-facing headline. Excluding the known test service (rather than allowlisting 'real' services) was the deliberate choice: at ruling time a fourth, legitimate service (agent-gradebook-verify) was already emitting graded decisions outside any allowlist that existed then, which an allowlist would have silently dropped from the headline. VARIABLES (#48): $decision_type, $model, and $grade_source are dashboard variables (DYNAMIC, attribute-backed off augmentloop.decision.type / gen_ai.request.model / augmentloop.grade.source on the metrics signal), replacing the old hardcoded decision-type allowlist. Every panel filters augmentloop.decision.type != 'build_session' UNCONDITIONALLY (not gated by the variable) so build_session stays excluded no matter what a judge selects; augmentloop.decision.type IN ($decision_type) is the selectable part, which is why a newly emitted decision type (e.g. eta_estimate, next_hop, or the pacing_choice type observed live on 2026-07-25) appears in the dropdown automatically with no panel edits. $model is applied the same way on every panel. $grade_source is NOT wired into this panel, panels 2-4, or the ai-judge panel 5 - each has an ADR-0001-driven fixed grade source (this one: math only per #54) that a shared dashboard variable must not be allowed to override; it is wired only into the two reality panels below.

filter.expression: augmentloop.grade.source = 'math' AND augmentloop.decision.type != 'build_session' AND augmentloop.decision.type IN ($decision_type) AND service.name != 'agent-gradebook-test' AND gen_ai.request.model IN ($model)

gen_ai.evaluation.score.label = 'correct' AND augmentloop.grade.source = 'math' AND augmentloop.decision.type != 'build_session' AND augmentloop.decision.type IN ($decision_type) AND service.name != 'agent-gradebook-test' AND gen_ai.request.model IN ($model)

widgets.description: Reality-graded correct rate (C9/#54): count(correct reality grades) / count(all reality grades) x 100, scoped to augmentloop.grade.source = 'reality'. Kept ADJACENT to the headline rather than blended into it - delayed reality grading is genuinely ours, and it stays visible on its own terms (ADR 0001 sets a ceiling on the headline, not a floor requiring both sources). Expected sparse: reality grades arrive later than the decisions they judge. Excludes service.name = 'agent-gradebook-test' (#47). VARIABLE (#48): augmentloop.grade.source is now driven by $grade_source instead of a hardcoded 'reality' literal, so a judge can switch this panel to inspect math or ai_judge grades in the same slot. KNOWN LIMITATION: this dashboard's saved schema has no persisted default-value field for a DYNAMIC variable (confirmed by round-tripping through the live PUT/GET on 2026-07-25 - the API accepted and echoed back the variable with no default/selectedValue key), so on first load with showALLOption this panel may show math+reality+ai_judge blended rather than reality alone until 'reality' is picked from the dropdown. Disclosed here rather than silently shipped.
